about: The Haftarah from the Prophets (Isaiah 40:27–41:16) answers a weary Israel with the God who gives strength to the faint. He calls Israel “Jacob whom I have chosen, offspring of Abraham my friend,” and promises: “Fear not, for I am with you.” The reading from the Apostles (Romans 4:1–12) goes with today’s chapter on circumcision. Shaul shows that Abraham’s faith was counted as righteousness before he was circumcised, so he is the father of all who believe, circumcised and uncircumcised.
